locations.title: Confessor Statue
locations.description:
Confessor Statues can be broken, leaving behind a portal accessible when the [Weight of True Guilt](#loc=118621) is equipped.

Each portal leads to a Confessor Dungeon with waves of enemies.
Clearing Confessor Dungeons upgrades the Thorn a total of seven times, with each giving the rewards:

1. 1000 Tears of Atonement

2. [Heart of the Single Tone](#loc=152212)

3. 3000 Tears of Atonement

4. [Embers of a Broken Star](#loc=152213)

5. 5000 Tears of Atonement

6. [Scaly Coin](#loc=152214)

7. [Seashell of the Inverted Spiral](#loc=152215)

**NB:** Clearing the 7th Dungeon transforms the **Thorn** into the [Cvstodia of Sin](#loc=150328), precluding you from Ending B. Therefore, only do so after you've attained [Ending B](#loc=152211).

locations.title: Alms Box
locations.description:
Donation box inside the church that can be interacted with allowing you to donate Tears of Atonement. Donating will upgrade the Alms Box at certain breakpoints of total ToA donated:

**Tier 1:** 2,000 total Tears of Atonement donated:
- Unlocks the "CONFESSOR" option at the Alms Box, allowing you to remove your guilt from the world for an incremental cost.

**Tier 2:** 5,000 total ToA:
- [Token of Appreciation](#loc=152186) rosary bead (need to exit the church and re-enter for it to appear).

**Tier 3:** 10,000 total ToA:
- Prie Dieu level 2 upgrade: Resting a the Prie Dieu fully refills your Fervor bar.

**Tier 4:** 20,000 total ToA:
- Prie Dieu level 3 upgrade: You are able to teleport between Prie Dieus.

**Tier 5:** 30,000 total ToA:
- Using the "Confessor" option at the Alms Box no longer costs Tears of Atonement.

**Tier 6:** 50,000 total ToA:
- [Cloistered Ruby](#loc=153530) rosary bead.

**Tier 7:** 100,000 total ToA donated:
- [Alms for Oblivion skin](#loc=153529)

locations.title: Chalice of Inverted Verses
locations.description:
**Location:** Held by the statue.

Fill the Chalice by defeating one of each of the enemies in the pictures, namely a Sleepless Tomb, Phalaris and Lionheart.

**NB:** The Chalice will be emptied if you die, use a Gate of Travel or teleport using an upgraded Prie Dieu.

**NB:** The route can be cheesed by reloading your save (which brings you back to your last used Prie Dieu). [Quirce](#loc=153322) must have been defeated for the shortcut between Convent of Our Lady of the Charred Visage and Wall of the Holy Prohibitions.

The steps are:

1. Save in [Albero's Prie Dieu](#loc=118541).

2. Use the Gate of Travel to [Mercy Dreams](#loc=118570).

3. Defeat the Sleepless Tomb in [The Sleeping Canvasses](#loc=153333). Exit the room and reload.

4. Use the Elevators from [Albero](#loc=118623) to make it all the way to the shortcut from [Convent of Our Lady of the Charred Visage](#loc=153329) to [Wall of the Holy Prohibitions](#loc=153326). 

5. Defeat the Lionheart in [Wall of the Holy Prohibitions](#loc=152788). Exit the room and reload.

6. Make your way to the Desecrated Cistern.

7. Defeat the Phalaris in [Mountains of the Endless Dusk](#loc=153338).

8. Finally, come back to this room and interact with the statue. The elevator skips the middle floors, need to drop down with [Linen of Golden Thread](#loc=152314) and [Three Gnarled Tongues](#loc=152208).

locations.title: Corpse

locations.title: Corpse

To safely get out, carefully drop down the left side to the platform below. From there you can see the broken bridge further down.

**Quote:** *On these cliffs, located at the foot of a snowy abyss, the roots of a secret await those who are patient...*

locations.title: Corpse
locations.description:

**Quote:** *It is closer now. The crying faces of ice announce the proximity of the convent. They presage the pain awaiting inside its walls. I ask the cold to be merciful and allow me to climb to the peaks, where I will be reborn as a sister of golden visage.*

locations.title: Corpse
locations.description: **Quote:** *What are those little ones that seem to hide up in the ceilings, amongst the ornaments of the altars? When I call them, they do not appear to pay me any mind. They are covered in ribbons that give the impression of fluttering in an invisible, imperceptible, constant wind... At times I hear them cry, and at times I hear them laugh. What are you, oh creatures of divine grace!?*

locations.title: Corpse
locations.description:

**Quote:** *It must be around here... The bell will no't stop ringing. I hear its jingling even in my dreams. My hands are wounded from all the digging. It must be around here... Just one more wound... I hear it close by...*

locations.title: Corpse

locations.title: Corpse

**Quote:** *I can bear it no longer. That sound... That ringing will follow me forever. No matter where I go. This is my sentence. It is time to cross towards the other side of this cursed dream.*

locations.title: Corpse
locations.description:

Their eyes anticipate sacrifices, anticipate pain, anticipate blood...*

media.title: Corpse - Convent of Our Lady of the Charred Visage

locations.title: Corpse
locations.description: **Quote:** *I can feel Our Lady between these walls. I can feel her warmth, for her face still burns, a reminder of her sacrifice and ours. The pain, the cold and the burn are our Rules.*

media.title: Corpse - Convent of Our Lady of the Charred Visage 2

locations.title: Corpse
locations.description: **Quote:** *Beneath the earth the paths are misleading. This is the lie that haunts these tunnels. The howl of the wind and the roar of the waves can be heard and yet, there is no wind or sea… Not even the blue flame atop the masts burns our hands…*

locations.title: Corpse
locations.description:
**Location:** Left and down from the Prie Dieu.

**Quote:** *Indeed, it is the Groan. It comes from the deepest core of this place, slithering in spirals, growing with its own echo, distorting amidst the bronze embossings. The cry of three intertwined throats born of a single penance, a single mourning. Light hardly ever reaches here, only the cold, and the Groan.*

locations.title: Corpse
locations.description:
**Location:** On the ground upon entering the area.

**Quote:** *A sacred light stains the highest branches of the iron tree. Its brilliances penetrates its walls into the hall where she rests, shrouding my eyes in purple darkness.*

locations.title: Corpse
locations.description:
**Location:** Down and right from the Prie Dieu.

**Quote:** *On this sacred floor I will be safe. They will hear neither my footsteps nor my fear. The Miracle wanted the oranges from those trees to make no sound on falling, so that only the wind through the columns and buttresses could be heard... Now I hear only the horrific screams of those punished by the Miracle. I will wait patiently.*

media.title: Corpse and Child of Moonlight - Patio of the Silent Steps

locations.title: Corpse
locations.description:
After returning to this area from the top right entrance.

**Quote:** *When I walk by the chapel of the Perpetual Agony, I can never bring myself to enter it. She still screams in pain like the very first day they brought her here. "A living miracle!" they said. The Miracle granted her wish and now we pray to her, watching her endless ordeal.*

locations.title: Corpse
locations.description:
**Location:** On the right side as you enter the area.

**Quote:** *I hear them reading. They mutter the forbidden writings. It is a constant murmuring whose echoes, once inside my mind, refuse to leave. I know that my curiosity will kill me, if my madness does not do it first.*

media.title: Corpse - Library of the Negated Words

locations.title: Corpse
locations.description:
**Location:** On the ground just as you enter from the east.

**Quote:** *How many more prayers does the Great Censer want? When will it tire and stop swaying? When will we be able to stand again? Lower your head... Close your eyes... Pray... And do not get up.*

locations.title: Corpse
locations.description:
**Location:** On an elevated platform as you enter the area.

Drop down and then loop around left, up and back right.

**Quote:** *I have witnessed the exhumation of the Archbishop. I have witnessed how they cleansed his bones in wine to then dress him in silk and gold. I saw them place the most beautiful jewels on his face and kiss his forehead. I watched as they placed rings on his fingers and kissed his hands. They lifted him up, calling his name, and swayed him to make it look as if he was walking again.*

locations.title: Corpse
locations.description: **Quote:** *The doors are deceiving me, they do not want me to go. The wals are the only ones that do not lie. Through the walls lies the way out of this place...*

media.title: Corpse - Library of the Negated Words 2

locations.title: Corpse

locations.title: Redento's Quest

**Quest Giver:** [Redento](#loc=152040)


**Task:** Help Redento with the obstacles in his journey.

1. [Mountains of The Endless Dusk](#loc=152040): Interact with the Lever to the west (need to go all around Jondo). **Reward:** [Fourth Toe made of Limestone](#loc=152147)

2. [Brotherhood of the Silent Sorrow](#loc=152149): Complete the center room to clear the boulder to his right.

3. [Wasteland of the Buried Churches](#loc=152226): Take down the trees to make a path over the spikes. **Reward:** [Little Toe made of Limestone](#loc=152227)

4. [Patio of the Silent Steps](#loc=152236): Defeat the Amargura in the area. **Reward:** [Big Toe made of Limestone](#loc=152772)

5. [Mother of Mothers](#loc=152260): Equip all 3 Toes Made from Limestone to move the statue and enter the room behind.


**Final Rewards:** [Nail Uprooted from Dirt](#loc=152773) in a glass chest in the last location, and [Knot of Rosary Rope](#loc=152774) after exiting and re-entering that hidden room.

**NB:** This Quest is linked to [Missable Achievement - Crossing Souls](#loc=152235).

- Place the [Egg of Deformity](#loc=152198) in the tree where you battled [Perpetva](#loc=152037) to receive the [Hatched Egg of Deformity](#loc=152207).

- Bring the [Hatched Egg of Deformity](#loc=152207) to the statue in [Lake of Silent Pilgrims](#loc=150442).

Defeating all 4 Amanecidas rewards the [Aubade of the Nameless Guardian](#loc=153947).

- [Hall of the Dawning](#loc=153951) after defeating [Laudes](#loc=153949).

**Final Rewards:**

locations.title: Missable Quest - Wounds of Eventide
locations.description:
**Quest Giver:** [Perpetva's Tomb](#loc=153674)

**Task:** Follow the True Path.

1. While progressing this quest, clear [Confessor Dungeons](#loc=152211). If you still want the other endings, then don't clear the last dungeon.

2. **NB:** Complete step 2 before fighting [Esdras, of the Anointed Legion](#loc=152221).  
Get [Incomplete Scapular](#loc=153924) by interacting with [Perpetva's Tomb](#loc=153674). 
3. Proceed as normal, reaching the **Bridge of the Three Calvaries** whenever you must. There, no fight with Esdras will take place.

4. **NB:** Complete steps 4-7 before fighting [Crisanta of the Wrapped Agony](#loc=153332).  
Talk to Esdras [in the Brotherhood of the Silent Sorrow](#loc=153926) to receive the [Key Grown from Twisted Wood](#loc=153925).

5. Talk to [Diosdado](#loc=152245) in the **Library of the Negated Words**, and complete his [Quest](#loc=152273). After he returns to his initial room, talk to him to reveal a [Door](#loc=153929).

6. Enter that door and greet [The Fourth Visage](#loc=153931), who requests the [Broken Left Eye of the Traitor](#loc=153695) and [Severed Right Eye of the Traitor](#loc=153667). 

7. Get both eyes by defeating [Isidora, Voice of the Dead](#loc=153662) and [Sierpes](#loc=153694), then deliver them to The Fourth Visage, getting the [Apodictic Heart of Mea Culpa](#loc=153934).

8. Equip the Apodictic Heart and defeat **Crisanta of the Wrapped Agony**. If you haven't equipped it, then when you approach her, a pop-up will warn you of this. She'll have a 2nd Phase.

9. Talk to Crisanta [in the Brotherhood of the Silent Sorrow](#loc=153935) to receive the [Holy Wound of Abnegation](#loc=153936).

10. Finally, if you must, then clear the 7th and last Confessor Dungeon, and proceed to defeat [His Holiness Escribar](#loc=153501), who will now have a 3rd Phase.

**Reward:** Ending C, [Exemplaris Excomunicationis](#loc=153953)

**NB:** This Quest locks you out of [Missable Achievement - Requiem Aeternam](#loc=150325).

locations.title: Missable Achievement - Mediterranean Diet
locations.description:
**NB:** This achievement is linked to [Tirso's Quest](#loc=150332).

**Save all Kissers of Wounds.**

If you defeat a major boss without having delivered "the previous" Herb, a Kisser of Wounds will die. The general idea is that Tirso must have at least 1 Herb "in stock" before each major boss fight. You can either do 1-1, or deliver 2/3 at once and then defeat 2/3 bosses in a row. The general flow would be something like:

- [Bouquet of Thyme](#loc=150439) before [Ten Piedad](#loc=150446)

- [Incense Garlic](#loc=150770) before [Our Lady of the Charred Visage](#loc=150917) 

- [Dried Clove](#loc=152148) and [Bouquet of Rosemary](#loc=152136) before [Tres Angustias](#loc=152200) and [Esdras, of the Anointed Legion](#loc=152221).

- [Olive Seeds](#loc=152232) and [Sooty Garlic](#loc=152298) before [Expósito, Scion of Abjuration](#loc=152324) and  [Melquíades, the Exhumed Archbishop](#loc=152272).

- Defeat [Quirce, Returned by the Flames](#loc=153322) and talk to Tirso one last time.

locations.title: Missable Achievement - The Path of the Unworthy
locations.description:
**Unlock ending B.** That is, complete the game **without** obtaining the Cvstodia of Sin NOR the [Holy Wound of Abnegation](#loc=153936).

Confessor Statues can be broken, and they leave behind a portal that can be accessed with the Weight of True Guilt equipped (equip the [Immaculate Bead](#loc=118621) and die 3 times). Each portal leads to a Confessor Dungeon with waves of enemies.

Clearing Confessor Dungeons upgrades the [Thorn](#loc=150328) (a total of 7 times, morphing it into the Cvstodia of Sin) and rewards Tears of Atonement or items. Namely:

1. 1000 Tears of Atonement

2. [Heart of the Single Tone](#loc=152212)

3. 3000 Tears of Atonement

4. [Embers of a Broken Star](#loc=152213)

5. 5000 Tears of Atonement

6. [Scaly Coin](#loc=152214)

7. [Seashell of the Inverted Spiral](#loc=152215)

After clearing the 7th Dungeon, the Thorn will have become the Cvstodia of Sin, so **do NOT** clear the last one until after you've unlocked ending B.

**Reward:** [True Apostasy](#loc=153515)

**NB:** Linked to [Missable Achievement - The Path of the Believer](#loc=153425).

locations.description:
**NB:** Without savescumming, Crossing Souls and [Rebirth](#loc=152267) are mutually exclusive.

**NB:** This achievement is linked to [Redento](#loc=152236) and [Cleofás' Quest](#loc=152266). 

**NB:** Do **NOT** talk to Lvdovico after meeting [Cleofás](#loc=152265).

**Provoke the meeting between Redento and Cleofás.**

1. Do **NOT** talk to [Redento](#loc=152236) in this area after beating the [Amargura](#loc=152237) (or, to be safe, don't talk to him at all). Redento must be in this area while you progress Cleofás' Quest.

2. Gather the three Marks of Refuge: [Mark of the First Refuge](#loc=152723), [Mark of the Second Refuge](#loc=152731) and [Mark of the Third Refuge](#loc=152737).

3. Give the three Marks to [Socorro](#loc=152264) and talk to Cleofás next to her.

4. Talk to [Cleofás](#loc=152744) in the Archcathedral Rooftops. Exit the area and re-enter.

5. Talk to [Redento](#loc=152236) here in this area.

locations.description:

3. Give the three Marks to [Socorro](#loc=152264) and then talk to Cleofás.
